open_items: The saved source is the earlier preprint. The citation record identifies a later journal version under a different title and author order; its reported results have not been verified here. Do not represent these extracted statistics as coming from the journal PDF.

Participant-level SDs, SEs, and confidence intervals for creativity ratings are not printed. Figure error bars are undefined. The projected-embedding standard deviations in Table 4 are diversity outcomes, not creativity-score standardizers.

Day 30 AUT novelty: Table 1 gives estimate -3.69, t=-2.12, p=0.038, while Table 2a gives Control 2.40 and GPT 2.56 and the narrative says no significant difference. The table sources are retained without reconciliation.

Day 30 AUT usefulness: Table 1 gives estimate -6.26 and t=-1.52, while Table 2a gives Control 5.62 and GPT 5.55, reversing the direction of the difference. The table sources are retained without reconciliation.
The number of Day 30 respondents by arm is not reported. Only the blanket Table 1 N=61 note covers its follow-up rows; the actual follow-up analysis count still needs confirmation.

Task 2 is rated as creativity in the methods and Table 2b, but called novelty in Table 1 and Figure 2b. Separate usefulness tests are printed without a clear methods description or tabulated arm means. This affects construct and primary-record selection.
The Day 7 Task 2 usefulness test contradicts the text claiming no significant final-session differences. The specific Table 1 result is retained.

For SBERT and string matching, pair selection, possible same-person pairs, pair counts, and the independence basis and method of the reported p-value bounds are not stated. Participant-level uncertainty cannot be established.
Tables 2a, 2b, and 3 contain blanket significance notes that conflict with specific tests or prose. They are not converted into outcome-specific p-values.
Table 4 dispersion sometimes runs opposite to the general claim of reduced diversity with ChatGPT. Printed values are retained with higher_is=more_diverse.
No primary outcome is named in the paper, and the linked preregistration content is not reproduced. The preregistration has not been accessed.
The exact follow-up timing anchor is inconsistent: the abstract says after 30 days of experiment completion, while the results say one month later and label the observation Day 30.
The release year of ChatGPT 4.0 is not stated in the paper; ai_tool.year is null. The study country is not stated.

Figure-only p-value precision was checked but not substituted for Table 1 values under extraction rule 1. In particular, the table's 0.000 entries must not be used as mathematically exact zero p-values.
notes: Reconciled on 2026-10-09 against the complete saved markdown conversion (including references and appendix) and PDF text extracted with pymupdf. The saved preprint is the source of these statistics; it is not the later journal article identified by the citation record. One randomized sample contributes repeated tasks and days. The extraction contains 128 distinct contrasts: 51 creativity/quality outcomes, 12 objective recognition-accuracy outcomes, and 65 diversity outcomes. All 15 numbered screening outcomes are represented, as are the additional quality ratings in the screening notes and the separate lexical/dispersion measures. The 13 only_in_a and 13 only_in_b entries are 13 matching contrasts with wording differences; each is included once. The earlier reconciliation reported n_added=0; subsequent PDF verification identified 12 eligible AUT recognition-accuracy contrasts omitted from both extractions, now included and documented in fixes. Table 1 differences and t statistics retain their printed control-minus-GPT direction.
